title: Enhancing Knowledge Density via Hierarchical Context Pruning for Retrieval-Augmented Repository-Level Code Completion
abstract: arXiv:2508.10068v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has advanced repository-level code completion by retrieving external code snippets, API documentation, or type definitions to expand the model's contextual awareness. However, under the finite token budget of the context window, existing retrieval-augmented methods often saturate the budget with highly similar or even redundant code, which not only wastes tokens but also suppresses critical cross-file dependencies, preventing synergistic interaction between semantically similar reference snippets and cross-file dependency definitions. Therefore, further gains are limited by low knowledge density in the retrieved context rather than by model capacity. We propose SaraCoder, a retrieval-augmented framework that enhances knowledge density via hierarchical context pruning under a fixed context budget. A Hierarchical Feature Optimization module prunes an over-complete candidate pool in four stages

translated_title: 通过分层上下文剪枝提升知识密度以实现检索增强的仓库级代码补全
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.10068v3 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：检索增强生成通过检索外部代码片段、API文档或类型定义来扩展模型的上下文感知能力，从而推动了仓库级代码补全的发展。然而，在上下文窗口有限的token预算下，现有的检索增强方法往往用高度相似甚至冗余的代码填满预算，这不仅浪费了token，还抑制了关键的跨文件依赖，阻碍了语义相似的参考片段与跨文件依赖定义之间的协同交互。因此，性能的进一步提升受到检索上下文中知识密度低的限制，而非模型能力的限制。我们提出了SaraCoder，一个在固定上下文预算下通过分层上下文剪枝来提升知识密度的检索增强框架。其中的分层特征优化模块分四个阶段对超完备的候选池进行剪枝……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SaraCoder框架，在固定上下文预算下通过分层上下文剪枝提升检索上下文的知识密度，避免冗余代码浪费token并释放跨文件依赖与相似代码片段的协同作用，从而提升仓库级代码补全性能。
en_tdlr: SaraCoder is a retrieval-augmented framework that enhances knowledge density through hierarchical context pruning under a fixed context budget, mitigating redundant retrieval and unlocking synergistic cross-file dependencies for improved repository-level code completion.
